newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ricoh develops copy machine parts recycling system.
newsitem.headline: Ricoh develops copy machine parts recycling system.

text.p: Ricoh Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it has developed a system to recycle parts of copying machines and plans to build lines for the new system at its factories in the United States and France.
The company installed the recycling line at its Numazu factory in central Japan in August with an investment of about 100 million yen, a company spokesman said.
It also plans to build similar lines at its factories in California and France within the next year, he said.
The line takes printing parts, including ink cartridges, and cleans them for recycling. It is able to recycle parts from 5,000 units per month, the spokesman said.
The company expects the firm to start to see profits of 10 million yen from the new line within one and a half years.
